reviewer.independence: Independent of closeout-helper author /root. Curator of manganese records and author of frontier report/builder; not an independent review of that own work.

scope: Static review of the corrected closeout helper and exact change against the reconstructed initial source. No execution or GitHub publication.

original_source_snapshot.basis: Reconstructed exactly from the complete initial tool output; not a contemporaneous initial-byte hash.

findings.resolution: The corrected helper binds preflight and postmerge identities, successful terminal commands, log hashes, all three topic-absence checks per run, exact expected counts and configuration, completed postmerge 317/3 test result, and cleanup clean_detached_worktree before forming a completion comment. Issue 211 tracks this implemented correction; its actual closure follows the fixing PR.

limitations: Static review does not establish a successful future run, merge, deletion or publication. Actual terminal receipts, remote states and exact GitHub comment readback remain required at execution.
